summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style overview of Dubai, describing it as the largest and most populous city in the United Arab Emirates. It covers the city's location on the Persian Gulf, its status as capital of the Emirate of Dubai, and the political role of Dubai and Abu Dhabi in the Federal Supreme Council. It also notes that Dubai will host World Expo 2020.
one_line: Overview of Dubai, the largest and most populous city in the United Arab Emirates, on the Persian Gulf.
key_facts: Dubai is the largest and most populous city in the United Arab Emirates (UAE).
Dubai is located on the southeast coast of the Persian Gulf.
Dubai is the capital of the Emirate of Dubai, one of the seven emirates that make up the UAE.
Abu Dhabi and Dubai are the only two emirates with veto power over critical matters of national importance in the UAE's Federal Supreme Council.
The city of Dubai is located on the emirate's northern coastline.
The city of Dubai heads the Dubai - Sharjah - Ajman metropolitan area.
Dubai's English pronunciation is given as doo - BY (/ duːˈbaɪ /).
